Welcome to Status Athlete's affiliate program

We are thrilled to extend an exclusive invitation to you to join the Status Athlete Affiliate Program. As a valued member of our sports and fitness community, your passion and dedication align perfectly with our mission to inspire and equip athletes at all levels.

By joining our affiliate program, you'll enjoy numerous benefits, including competitive commission rates, early access to our latest products, and the opportunity to be featured across our marketing channels. It's a fantastic opportunity to turn your influence and enthusiasm for sports and fitness into rewards.

Here’s what being part of our program entails:

• Your Own Unique 20% Discount Code: Share your dedicated 20% discount coupon with friends and your entire network, saving them money.

• Earn 15% Commission: Receive a 15% commission on every purchase made using your unique code, with weekly automatic payouts directly to your account (PayPal).

FOUNDED BY ATHLETES FOR ATHLETES

We are a collective of elite athletes who came together with a shared vision;
to provide you with products that cultivate DRIVE, CONFIDENCE, MENTAL STRENGTH and GRIT.

We understand the importance of feeling your finest so you can play
your finest and we know firsthand the significance of having the right mindset and gear to
perform at your very best.

OUR MISSION is to help you be the best you can
be, day after day. All of our products are designed to empower
athletes and help them reach their full potential on and of the field.


• Best Seller Product description: 

They Will Know Your Name

Just like you, this ultimate custom piece of art is created to showcase your unique identity as an Elite athlete, one piece at a time. This exclusive jewelry features your jersey number and your family name, all encrusted with exquisite sparkling 3mm 5A grade Zirconia stones.

This unique piece is not just a jewelry, it's a Masterpiece that embodies Strength, Confidence, Uniqueness and Power. It catches the eye and attracts attention, just like you. It symbolizes who you are, it represents your parents, your brothers, and sisters, it’s a tribute to your whole family and your status as a top athlete.

Comes with a handmade S.A Diamond chain, featuring 4mm 5A grade Zirconia stones for added shine and sparkle, it is sure to make a statement. It will be remembered by your fans and teammates. They will notice you, they will see you, they will remember you, they will know your name.
